jijimon.name: Jijimon
jijimon.role: The village elder. Keeps the quest log and the story of the Black Gears.

tentomon.name: Tentomon
tentomon.role: A curious explorer - sends parties out to survey the island.

leomon.name: Leomon
leomon.role: The forest's guardian, freed from a Black Gear. Escorts you across the island - and trains a second partner with you.

elecmon.name: Elecmon
elecmon.role: Caretaker of the island's eggs - builds new incubation slots.

yokomon-village.name: Yokomon Village
yokomon-village.role: Biyomon's villagers, saved from the mountain's fire - run the Mystery Egg stall.

frigimon.name: Frigimon
frigimon.role: Freezeland's gentle keeper, lost in a blizzard that never ends.

hagurumon.name: Hagurumon
hagurumon.role: A stray cog from the factory that builds itself.

andromon.name: Andromon
andromon.role: The factory's master, freed from its core - opens the Shop, retunes Digimon's special abilities, and tunes a third partner for you.

whamon.name: Whamon
whamon.role: The lake's gentle giant - will carry you across the sea.

kiwimon.name: Kiwimon
kiwimon.role: A ruin-dweller who knows every carving by heart.

centarumon.name: Centarumon
centarumon.role: Guardian of the ruins, freed - reads the eight symbols of the Crests.
